**Texas Commercial Solar Leads Market – Multi‑Angle Brief**

**1. Market Size & Growth (Scout)**  
- No direct public figure for the Texas commercial‑solar‑leads market value was found within the search limits.  
- Proxy: Texas ranks #2 nationally for installed solar PV capacity at **≈41,460 MW (Q4 2024)**【https://www.biscred.com/post/how-smart-solar-companies-use-data-to-generate-solar-leads】.  
- Lead‑generation efficiency indicator: SolarReviews reports customers generate **$6–$8 gross margin per $1 spent on leads**【https://www.solarreviews.com/solar-leads】.  
- Specific CAGR or percentage growth rate for the leads market was not located in the allowed searches.

**2. Competitors & Lead Pricing (Analyst)**  
- **Top competitors** (Texas‑focused or national platforms active in TX):  
  - *Abstrakt Marketing Group* – B2B appointment‑setting, exclusive per market.  
  - *EnergySage* – Solar marketplace delivering shared, high‑intent homeowner leads.  
  - *Modernize* – Home‑improvement lead platform offering shared & exclusive solar leads.  
  - *SolarReviews* – Consumer review/marketplace providing shared solar leads from homeowners researching installers.  
- **Typical lead pricing**:  
  - Shared leads: **$30 – $100 per lead** (common marketplace range).  
  - Exclusive leads: premium, custom‑quoted (e.g., Abstrakt’s appointment‑setting service).  
  - Commercial appointment‑setting/lead‑gen services: custom pricing based on market, volume, scope (not publicly listed).  
- Sources: ActiveProspect guide, SolarReviews overview, industry blog on lead cost, and ConvertCalculator pricing context【https://activeprospect.com/blog/buy-solar-leads/】【https://www.solarreviews.com/solar-leads】【https://pipe.solar/blogs/solar-leads-cost】【https://www.convertcalculator.com/blog/buying-solar-leads/】.
